faq.q: Can you swim and dive underwater in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Yes. Scuba diving and underwater exploration are shown on Rockstar's official GTA VI site and in the Extended Look gameplay video released 27 August 2026, set around the Leonida Keys.

faq.q: Where does underwater exploration happen in GTA 6?
faq.a: It is set around the Leonida Keys, the map's tropical southern archipelago. Official imagery shows a diver near a coral reef alongside marine life such as a sea turtle.

faq.q: Are there shipwrecks to explore in GTA VI?
faq.a: Press coverage of the Extended Look and later preview sessions describes underwater environments including shipwrecks and submerged caves as part of the game's open-world activities.

faq.q: Is scuba diving officially confirmed by Rockstar or just reported by press?
faq.a: It is officially confirmed. Rockstar's own site, rockstargames.com/VI, and the Extended Look video both show scuba diving directly, making this a first-party confirmation rather than a press report.

faq.q: What other water activities were shown alongside diving in GTA 6?
faq.a: The same Extended Look footage also showed other water-based content such as parachuting and boating, alongside the underwater exploration, according to press coverage of the video.
